drafted_from: tool:read-codex-usage's own row (its words, input schema and invoke block) and read-data/read-codex-usage.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read how much of each Codex account's weekly window is used and when it resets", with {}. It runs tool:read-codex-usage on this computer and tells you each account by its label, with the percent used and the reset time.
no_lists_because: It takes no input and answers from codex-lb on this computer, and keeps no row; the hourly recipe keeps the rows in provider_limits.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read how much of each Codex account's weekly window is used and when it resets", and give it nothing more: the input is {}.
2. The AI calls tool:read-codex-usage with {}. This computer must report the codex-lb door; if it does not, the answer says so in words and nothing is read.
3. Read the answer: each row names an account as codex-lb account N, its used percent, its reset time and when it was read. No key, id or email is returned.
4. To keep these readings for the chooser, the hourly recipe workflow:keep-codex-usage-in-provider-limits calls the same tool and writes the rows into provider_limits.
